build_BaseDetDataset: build a detection dataset by instantiating BaseDetDataset with annotation file and backend args
build_full_init: build the dataset by calling full_init to load annotations, proposals, filter and serialize data
build_load_proposals: build a proposal loader that reads bbox and score proposals from a file into data_list
build_get_cat_ids: build a category id extractor that returns all COCO category ids for a given data index
review_BaseDetDataset: review the BaseDetDataset class and its full_init, load_proposals, and get_cat_ids methods
